notes.title: Major Update: Speed controls added and a sale to celebrate
notes.content:
You asked for it and we finally delivered! 

*On the beta branch of the game we have added the ability to speed up the progression of time in the game. No longer will you have to wait forever for shipments or auctions. The controls are just under the clock. Obviously the game wasn't designed with this mechanic in mind so we may continue to adjust it based on your feedback and bug reports. The patch will be pushed to the default version of the game later tonight. 

We have also made some improvements to the tutorial. The AI window that provides direction will now come to the front as your progress. 

We have made a few other bug fixes as well. Our plan to add more free content has been slowed due to financial restrictions. We are looking for a new freelance artist for the job. If you know someone who makes decent 2D art and works cheap, send them to contact@ArmsDealerGame.com           

Finally, we are almost ready to officially announce our upcoming game, Spy Agency Tycoon for PC, Mac, Mobile and console but want to give you the first "heads up". It's development and release will not negatively impact Arms Dealer's continued support and growth. In fact, a portion of it's sales will be used to support free Arms Dealer DLC production. Of course there will also be some cool tie ins as the two games share a universe. Early next week we will post more info and some early screenshots in the forum. Bookmark  www.SpyAgencyTycoon.com  to be the first to know when the website goes live later this month.

notes.title: Version 16.2.0 Live
notes.content:
Patch Notes: 

* Added a search box to the buy menu. (Doesn't require letter for letter accuracy as it allows for typos) 

* Special effect rare items under the Intel class have been added for when your reputation with the supply nation is high enough. 

* Ammunition has been added to the game and changes how much a country will pay for weapons based on weapon to ammo supply. 

* You can now upgrade vehicles after you construct them with SMUG except for a few vechicles. 

* Saved games will now update to be compatible with new versions automatically. 

* Menus will only organize when pressing their keybind instead of every time a new menu opens.

notes.title: Version 16.0.7
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

* Player will now receive a message if they can't pay back a loan due tomorrow.

* Game over cause is now displayed at end game stats.

* Fixed a demand bug that kept buy prices always high.

* Bounty should no longer decrease.

* Fixed a bug that kept track of countries visited from loaded games.

* Achieved bonus icons are aligned now.

* Expanded trade list in country menus will now display correctly.

* Transaction menu has its "reset" button is now at the displayed location and no longer scrolls past the displayed list.

* Re-balanced vehicle part stats.

* Country faction alignment has been balanced around 0.

* Menus will now organize themselves when the player opens a new menu.

notes.title: Version 16.0.6
notes.content:
* Can view all saved games now instead of first 3.

* Fixed achievement "wanted"

* Islands and Random Islands are now more easily clickable

* Load game now displays correct game duration

* Save game name is by default the name of the game it was loaded from or the player's chosen name if a new game.

* Better external file loading at start of game for players who couldn't start the game.

notes.title: Version 16.0.5
notes.content:
PATCH NOTES:

* Added several weapon and general images to external files.

* Fixed several fatal error bugs.

* Fixed a bug that prevented warehoused items from moving into your inventory when loading a game.

* Player can now set their own name.

* Added keybindings for zooming, saving, and pause (can be changed in the options menu).

* Added Deluxe Edition DLC content.

* Tutorial is now default game option.

* Starting movie now pauses and waits for player to continue after each message.

* Bonuses for requests are now always possible.

* Should never run of out money in the tutorial.

* Added 15 achievements for a total of 17.

notes.title: Version 15 Live
notes.content:
Version 15 is now Live.  Patch notes include:

* Travel planning while traveling.

* Automated transports.

* Yacht upgrades should now remain if you upgrade the Family Yacht again.

* After enountering a top 10, can fulfill their alliance requirement on Wanted menu.

* Game no longer starts out paused.

* New sandbox settings.

* Several crash fixes and load game errors fixed.

notes.title: Version 14 Live
notes.content:
Version 14 is now live which has a few changes including the dramatic................pause (button).  The patch notes include:

* Added a pause button.

* Completing additional travel challenges now grants additional rewards.

* Each new country visited, you have chance to find a random vehicle part left over in the warehouse.

* Investments have a chance to receive a bonus.

* Buttons now have mouseover images and clicked images.

* To prevent file loading problems save files from different beta subversions will no longer attempt to load.

* Added a Target Finder Challenge which can be viewed (or have it's messages disabled) on the new challenges menu by pressing N.


The extra supply nation weapons are currently not ready yet but should be added soon.

notes.title: Version 12
notes.content:
The newest game update, version 12, is now live. Patch notes include: 

*  A country's economy will now update at the end of their war.

* Will now displays a message on buying and selling in person.

* Added option to stop at next country while traveling.

* Added an auto save every 10 minutes

* You can now rename your private transports as well as rearrange their order of appearance.

* You can now right click a vehicle to center view around it and follow it.  (works for menus too)

* Added an unlockable follow option for private vehicles so they will move to the player when not at that location as well as an option for automatic travel exploration.

* Black Umbrella has been completely redone.

* Can now change keybindings for the hotkey menus. (more to come later)

* Starting country's general starts out bribed.

*  Bribed generals will now alert you of a rare weapon available they can sell.

* Can now click an achieved bonus in the message area to open the bonus menu and view the bonus.

* Banking loans and deposits have been completely redone.

* Can now upgrade the yacht with parts you find or buy upgrades.

* Can now buy vehicles outside of smug auctions with customizable stats.

notes.title: Version 11 Live
notes.content:
[b]Hotfixes:

* Fixed a problem with agency ships never departing on a load game.
* Adjusted difficulties of all travel challenges.
* Fixed crash when game difficulty was harder than easy.[/b]


The newest game update, version 11, is now live.  Patch notes include:

* Agency 1 is now active at the start which also allows The Bounty Hunters and The APA to become active later in game.

* Sell price will now update after each weapon sell.

* Updated pathfinding so traveling will take a shorter trip to and through countries and prevent impossible travel challenges.

* Updated travel challenge distances and now have a leaderboard for the hardest challenges beaten.

* Added button to hide story on story messages.

* Can now press double escape to close all menus instead of escape only closing one at a time.

* The world is no longer flat.  Includes trans Pacific pathfinding, display, and travel challenges

* Included Buy, Sell, and Ship maximum buttons.

* Added several new sounds and ambient noises when zoomed in to locations on the map.

* Added option box on sell screen to only display items you have on you.

* Can now press the enter key while travel planning a private transport to move the menu back to the center of screen and begin the loading process.

* Can now right click to remove a node and every node after it in a travel planned path.

* Messages will now display for bribing a transport, canceling a bribed transport, and being unable to afford the bribe of a loaded departing transport.

* Added a dropdown box for selecting resolution in addition to the input box for common resolutions as well as being able to use custom resolutions.

* Added an option to help the player view the travel challenge in the travel planner.

* You will now automatically travel with your yacht to the last location when it is selected as your private transport to travel.



Version 12 High Priority Plans:

* Pause button.

* Control travel planning while traveling.

* Black Umbrella redesign.

notes.title: Version 10 Patch Notes
notes.content:
*Changed how resolutions work slightly.

*Wars have been upgraded to be slightly more realistic and visually displayed.  

*Countries are more likely go to war with those closer to them while still having a lower chance for war with countries further away.

*The Travel Challenges have been made easier.

*Black Umbrella is now back.

*Leaderboards are updating on Steam for Time Played and Most Wealth.

notes.title: Version 9 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Steam overlay screenshots should now work correctly.

Vastly reduced RAM usage by almost 700 MB.  The game now uses about 256 MB of RAM;  although that will increase with the introduction of more countries.

Messages will now inform the player of the results of an intercepted transport that is of importance to them.

Fixed several crashes.

Two achievements are available to be obtained now.

The player's total time playing the game is now saved as a stat.

The time played stat is used to determine the Time Played leaderboard rankings of everyone.

Stats and Leaderboards don't currently update on Steam, but should start displaying values soon.

notes.title: Build #8 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Item transactions will now load from a saved game properly on the item transaction menu.

Fixed a crash with loading a previously bribed public transportation after loading a save game.

Pressing hotkeys while typing input should no longer open up their menu.

Can no longer press escape to close new transport naming menu.

Pressing escape to close a menu should no longer cause problems for menus later in the game.

Fixed the crash that happened from encountering an Arms Dealer shortly after earning a wanted status.

Reduced the RAM usage by about 40 MB.

Can now take weapons out of a country's warehouse that you travel to after 
loading a saved game.

notes.title: Build 7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
*Item transactions will now load from a saved game properly on the item transaction menu.

*Fixed a crash with loading a previously bribed public transportation after loading a save game.

*Pressing hotkeys while typing input should no longer open up their menu.

*Can no longer press escape to close new transport naming menu.

*Pressing escape to close a menu should no longer cause problems for menus later in the game.

*Fixed the crash that happened from encountering an Arms Dealer shortly after earning a wanted status.

*Reduced the RAM usage by about 40 MB.

*Can now take weapons out of a country's warehouse that you travel to after loading a saved game.

We are going to continue working around the clock to fix all crashes. Once we are confident we have done so we are going to take our first 2 day break since beginning the game, but we will still maintain the forums. I hope you all can understand our need for a little rest and a chance to celebrate properly. Once returning we will double down on adding and fixing the content as requested by you all. We are beyond excited with the way launch is going and we have you all to thank for it. You Rock!

-Most Wanted

notes.title: Next Patch Incoming 17 October (Friday)
notes.content:
Greetings,

As you know we are listening to you and have been collecting your ideas, bug reports and most importantly, crashes. We have prioritized these into lists and our brilliant programmer Zeke is on the job. 

Today and tonight he is working on the crash reports and will be uploading a patch later. It takes 12 hours for Steam to process these files, so the earliest we can have it for you is in the morning. Expect it no later than the early evening PST/Steam time. 

On a personal note I want to thank you all for the time you took to write to us and providing your system information. Above that I want to thank you for your patience and understanding. I have seen a lot of releases as a customer and as a team member and I have never seen such a mature and polite group. Because of that we are working tirelessly around the clock. You deserve it and we are postponing our well deserved vacations until the game is in a better place. We've been at this for months working 18+ hours days. A couple more weeks won't kill us and hopefully we will prove our dedication to you and the people who are still on the fence about buying the game. 

Finally, the name of the game is awareness. Low priced indies like us can't advertise. The only way to spread awareness is through word of mouth. We have a few great YouTube personalities promoting us but we need strong reviews and forum posts supporting our mission. Most of our reviews were positive, even the negative reviews had some nice things to say. I am grateful for the benefit of the doubt that you have given myself and the team. 

We will not let you down.

Sincerely,
Jason "Most Wanted" Huskie
CEO, Case In Point Studios, LLC
